create_stats_instance: create a Stats instance to track generation phases and token throughput
build_phase_stats: build a PhaseStats dataclass with name, token count, and elapsed time
test_phase_method: test the Stats.phase method to start a named generation phase with token count
summarize_end_phase: summarize the Stats.end_phase method to terminate a phase and record stats
review_phase_stats_show: review the PhaseStats.show method to display tokens, time, and throughput
